conversations.task: `top_k` in src/ranking.py returns items in the wrong order when two scores tie. Fix it and add a regression test.
conversations.result:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Item:
    id: str
    score: float
    created: int


def top_k(items: Iterable[Item], k: int) -> list[Item]:
    """Highest scores first; ties keep the newest item first."""
    ranked = sorted(items, key=lambda it: it.score, reverse=True)
    return ranked[:k]


def normalize(items: list[Item]) -> list[Item]:
    if not items:
        return []
    hi = max(it.score for it in items)
    lo = min(it.score for it in items)
    span = hi - lo or 1.0
    return [Item(it.id, (it.score - lo) / span, it.created) for it in items]

conversations.task: The nightly backup skips the database when the disk is almost full, and nobody notices. Make scripts/backup.sh fail loudly instead, and log how much space was free.
conversations.result:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

DEST=/var/backups/app
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)
mkdir -p "$DEST"

free_kb=$(df --output=avail "$DEST" | tail -n 1)
if [ "$free_kb" -lt 5000000 ]; then
  echo "low disk, skipping database"
else
  pg_dump -Fc app > "$DEST/db-$STAMP.dump"
fi

tar -czf "$DEST/uploads-$STAMP.tar.gz" /srv/app/uploads
find "$DEST" -type f -mtime +14 -delete
